body: Gurdeep Soni (Chairman & MD) on the Q1FY26 call (2025-08-11), volunteered: "inventory replenishment has begun and Uniparts anticipates mid-teens growth in this segment" Metric: Small-ag segment revenue FY26 YoY. Target: ~+15%. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: SILENTLY-DROPPED. Evidence: No FY26 small-ag growth figure was ever reported, though in Q2FY27 they did give quarterly segment growth (small ag +25% YoY). Agriculture revenue fell from ~INR 970 cr (FY23) to ~INR 717 cr (FY26) (analyst figures, Q2FY27 call). Unverifiable rather than proven missed; this is the most debatable status in the set.
